# 12-Color Glitter Hexagon Sequin Nail Art Set

Add sparkle to every manicure and craft project with this 12-color glitter hexagon sequin set. Each shade is packed in its own case, so you can create bold multicolor designs or keep to a single favorite.

## Hexagon Sequins in a Full Color Range

The hexagon-shaped sequins catch light from every angle, giving nail designs a dimensional shine. Mix shades for ombré effects, accent nails, or full glitter coverage. Having 12 colors on hand means you can try new looks without buying separate sets.

## Organized, Sturdy Storage

The sturdy cases stack neatly at your nail station, so each color stays visible and within reach. Less time searching for shades means more time on your designs.

## Beyond the Nail Bench

Hexagon sequins also work well for shaker cards, bookmarks, resin pieces, and epoxy molds. A generous amount of product gives you room to experiment across hobbies and projects.

## Start Creating Today

Stock your nail art kit with a versatile palette that works for salon-style designs and DIY crafts alike. Add this set to your cart and start designing.

---

**Notes for you:**
- **Brand mismatch:** The title says Ostart, but the description says NYKKOLA. I used Ostart from the title. Please confirm the correct brand before publishing.
- **Features:** The features field was empty, so I drew the features (12 colors, hexagon sequins, stackable sturdy cases) from the title and description.
- **Omitted on purpose:** I left out the sequin size, color accuracy, translucency, and glitter-dust concerns from the reviews, along with the shipping comments, since the copy should not describe weaknesses or delivery times.
